title: [Mechanisms of Shenghui Decoction in activating PPARalpha to promote microglial phagocytosis and degradation of Abeta].
authors: Wang, Yu-Min; Wang, Min; Huang, Yan-Li; Xu, Dai-Yu; Gao, Gai; Zhang, Xiao-Wei; Zhang, Zhen-Qiang; Xie, Zhi-Shen
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药圣惠方通过PPARalpha/TFEB通路促进小胶质细胞吞噬降解Abeta，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞实验与信号通路验证，非TF-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: This study aimed to elucidate the potential mechanisms by which Shenghui Decoction(SHD) promotes microglial cells to phagocytose and degrade surrounding deposited beta-amyloid protein(Abeta) through the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha(PPARalpha)/transcription factor EB(TFEB) signaling pathway. Multiple approaches, including Western blot, real-time quantitative PCR(RT-qPCR), molecular docking, reporter gene assays, and immunofluorescence, were employed for verification. Mouse microglial cells(BV2 cells) were divided into the control group, model group, positive control(WY14643) group, and SHD low-, medium-, and high-dose groups(50, 100, and 200 mug.mL~(-1)), respectively. An Abeta-induced BV2 cell injury model was established, and different reagents were added according to group assignment. BV2 cell viability was assessed using the MTT assay. Fluorescently labeled Abeta_(1-42)(FAM-Abeta_(1-42))was used to evaluate Abeta phagocytosis and degradation in each group. Reporter gene assays were performed to determine the transcriptional activities of PPARalpha and TFEB. RT-qPCR was conducted to detect the expression of low-density lipoprotein receptor(LDLR), autophagy-related genes 5 and 7(Atg5 and Atg7), and lysosome-associated membrane protein 2(LAMP2). Western blot was used to determine the expression levels of PPARalpha, LDLR, TFEB nuclear translocation, microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3 Ⅰ and Ⅱ(LC3Ⅰ and LC3Ⅱ), P62, and LAMP2 proteins. Immunofluorescence was employed to further validate TFEB nuclear translocation. Molecular docking analysis was conducted to evaluate the binding between SHD active constituents and the ligand-binding domain of PPARalpha. The results showed that SHD had no significant effect on BV2 cell viability at concentrations of 50-300 mug.mL~(-1). SHD enhanced Abeta phagocytosis and degradation, upregulated LDLR expression, significantly increased the nuclear translocation and expression levels of PPARalpha and nuclear TFEB proteins, and enhanced the transcriptional activities of PPARalpha and TFEB. SHD significantly upregulated the expression of the autophagy-related genes Atg5 and Atg7 and the lysosome-related gene LAMP2, increased the protein expression levels of LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ and LAMP2, and significantly decreased P62 protein expression. Molecular docking results indicated that 50 active constituents in SHD could bind to the ligand-binding domain of PPARalpha and form stable hydrogen bonds, with binding energies <-5 kcal.mol~(-1). In summary, SHD improves the autophagic-lysosomal function in BV2 cells, thereby facilitating the phagocytosis and degradation of Abeta. This underlying mechanism is likely associated with the activation of the PPARalpha/TFEB signaling pathway.The findings of this study help elucidate the modern scientific connotation of SHD and may provide a rational therapeutic strategy for the clinical prevention and treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在阐明升慧汤（SHD）通过过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（PPARα）/转录因子EB（TFEB）信号通路促进小胶质细胞吞噬并降解周围沉积的β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）的潜在机制。采用多种方法进行验证，包括蛋白质印迹法、实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）、分子对接、报告基因检测和免疫荧光法。小鼠小胶质细胞（BV2细胞）分别分为对照组、模型组、阳性对照（WY14643）组以及SHD低、中、高剂量组（50、100和200 μg·mL⁻¹）。建立Aβ诱导的BV2细胞损伤模型，并根据分组添加不同试剂。使用MTT法评估BV2细胞活力。采用荧光标记的Aβ₁₋₄₂（FAM-Aβ₁₋₄₂）评估各组Aβ的吞噬和降解情况。进行报告基因检测以确定PPARα和TFEB的转录活性。通过RT-qPCR检测低密度脂蛋白受体（LDLR）、自噬相关基因5和7（Atg5和Atg7）以及溶酶体相关膜蛋白2（LAMP2）的表达。使用蛋白质印迹法测定PPARα、LDLR、TFEB核转位、微管相关蛋白1轻链3Ⅰ和Ⅱ（LC3Ⅰ和LC3Ⅱ）、P62及LAMP2蛋白的表达水平。采用免疫荧光法进一步验证TFEB核转位。进行分子对接分析以评估SHD活性成分与PPARα配体结合域的结合情况。结果显示，SHD在50-300 μg·mL⁻¹浓度下对BV2细胞活力无显著影响。SHD增强了Aβ的吞噬和降解，上调了LDLR表达，显著增加了PPARα和核TFEB蛋白的核转位及表达水平，并增强了PPARα和TFEB的转录活性。SHD显著上调了自噬相关基因Atg5和Atg7及溶酶体相关基因LAMP2的表达，增加了LC3Ⅱ/LC3Ⅰ和LAMP2的蛋白表达水平，并显著降低了P62蛋白表达。分子对接结果表明，SHD中的50种活性成分能与PPARα的配体结合域结合并形成稳定氢键，结合能<-5 kcal·mol⁻¹。总之，SHD改善了BV2细胞的自噬-溶酶体功能，从而促进Aβ的吞噬和降解。这一潜在机制可能与激活PPARα/TFEB信号通路有关。本研究结果有助于阐明SHD的现代科学内涵，并可能为阿尔茨海默病的临床防治提供合理的治疗策略。
